articles.title: Canal Park Gets $12,000 for Book Exchange Box
articles.deck: Residents of Canal Park filled the hall on Friday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 22 weeks once it begins. The group has raised $12,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

Karl Renner, who has lived in Canal Park for 22 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Friday mornings.
The plan calls for book exchange box along Garden Place, with work expected to start in March.

articles.title: Letter: the Foxglove Heights Neighbors Did a Good Job This Spring
body: To the editor: I have lived on Linden Court for 16 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foxglove Heights Neighbors has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the footpath repair in the budget. Many of us on Linden Court use it every week.
Cyrus Salazar, Upper Commons

articles.title: Lamar Zielinski, 82, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Lamar Zielinski for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats.
Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Lamar Zielinski spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Mill Hill Lions Club in his or her name.

articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1991 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Briar Lane from the corner of Clover Road.

body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
